# Start hacking

**Build Tacto. First target: one complete negotiation and an instrumented RFQ sandbox run.**
Do not begin by implementing every strategy or polishing a dashboard.

Team times are Europe/Berlin, Saturday 10 and Sunday 11 October 2026.

## First 15 minutes

1. Assign Runtime, Evidence and Evaluation/pitch owners; Samet owns Decision/integration.
2. Follow [root setup](../README.md). Custom prep/play/run/report commands now execute; serial remains the
   default, async is explicit. Current hosted results are in experiments/LOG.md.
3. Read [implementation gates](10-implementation-checklist.md) together. Agree on package,
   claim, thread-state and closing-proposal records before splitting up.
4. Runtime + Evaluation run D01 and the D02 timing probe. Decision builds full-cost checks.
   Evidence prepares supplier facts and validates units. Save observations, not assumptions.
5. Ask the [design questions](08-open-questions.md): queued RFQ calls, closing near the wave
   cap, price-unit normalization and jury criteria.

## First useful version

One custom case completes end to end. The coordinator exists from the first concurrent runner;
every closing path runs identical checks. Invalid/stale offers cannot be accepted; model work
has a bounded fallback; a request cannot be duplicated on retry. Costs and decisions are traced.
Hosted timing is measured. Then scale to multiple cases.

## Read by role

| Owner | Read first | First deliverable |
|---|---|---|
| Decision / Samet | 02, 03, 10 | Complete-package evaluator and closing policy |
| Runtime | 00, 02, 06, 10 | D02 clock evidence and safe coordinator |
| Evidence | 01, 02, 03 | Typed facts with supplier, part, units and dates |
| Evaluation/pitch | 04, 05, 07 | Baseline report, quota ledger and replay requirements |

## Document map

- [Coding-agent lab playbook](../LAB_PLAYBOOK.md): laptop setup and the tracked experiment workflow.
- [00 — Challenge contract](00-challenge.md): official rules, score, limits and schedule.
- [01 — Research](01-research.md): reproduced findings, estimates and hypotheses.
- [02 — Architecture](02-architecture.md): ownership, state, deadlines and interfaces.
- [03 — Playbook](03-playbook.md): hard checks versus policies to test.
- [04 — Experiments](04-experiments.md): quota, holdout and promotion criteria.
- [05 — Team and timeline](05-team-and-timeline.md): build order and milestones.
- [06 — Final runbook](06-final-runbook.md): release, preflight, freeze and recovery.
- [07 — Pitch](07-pitch.md): demonstrate judgment with measured evidence.
- [08 — Open questions](08-open-questions.md): organizer answers and resulting decisions.
- [09 — Risks](09-risks.md): failure modes and validation.
- [10 — Implementation checklist](10-implementation-checklist.md): actual scaffold gaps and gates.
- [11 — Pipeline and win plan](11-pipeline-and-win-plan.md): one-page order, gates and cut list.
- [12 — Measured improvement plan](12-measured-improvement-plan.md): full hosted coverage, P04 target,
  reproduced policy gaps and the next bounded experiment sequence.

- [13 — Staged experiments](13-staged-experiments.md): current implementation, four-run screening,
  conditional 52-session ceiling, stop gates and FAQ implications. Supersedes document 12's budget.

- [14 — Measured demo](14-measured-demo.md): two defensible replay stories and their limits.

- [12 — Experiment dashboard](12-experiment-dashboard.md): shared laptop-hosted dashboard,
  local experiment runners, comparisons, buffering and importing previous attempts.

- [13 — Agent experiment loop](13-agent-experiment-loop.md): immutable checkpoints, bounded
  comparisons, cited findings, recovery and safe local/recommendation restore.

## Sources and evidence labels

Audited kit and current lockfile: `1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53`.
[Source snapshot](https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/tree/1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53).
Start with `brief/api.md`, `brief/brief.md`, `brief/submission.md`, `data/company.md`,
`data/README.md` and row-level provenance. Record upgrades and rerun relevant checks.
Resolve conflicting official statements with the desk; public jury weighting is still unresolved.

- **CONTRACT:** official rule/API, subject to recorded organizer clarification.
- **MEASURED LOCAL:** kit/data/simulator reproduction; not hosted persuasion evidence.
- **MEASURED HOSTED:** saved run IDs and configuration support the observation.
- **INFERRED / HYPOTHESIS:** plausible explanation or policy awaiting an experiment.
- **IMPLEMENTED:** code and relevant checks exist; a plan or scaffold test is insufficient.

Hosted sandbox observations are recorded in [the experiment log](../experiments/LOG.md).
They do not establish generalization, final readiness or a winning probability.
# Implementation checklist — read before coding

Snapshot: documentation finalized against scaffold on 10 October 2026. This is an explicit
backlog, not a claim the agent works. Update boxes only with test/run evidence.

## Current implementation

PackageAgent v0.2 uses one closing evaluator through both serial and async orchestration.
The async runner journals requests, reconciles and resumes; one hosted D02 crash/restart
completed the same session with zero timeouts. Prep, reporting and the replay viewer execute.
Verified claims are integrated behind NEGOTIATOR_CLAIMS=1, limited to single-supplier
price-increase cases. P01 improved from 80.0 to 92.8 in a two-repeat comparison. Estimates,
MESOs and claims remain off by default; model interpretation/writing is not implemented.
Full final-machine, wave-cap, concurrent-load and Sunday-release rehearsal remains outstanding.
See the [experiment log](../experiments/LOG.md) for exact scopes and limitations.

Only a supplier's standing (first) sheet is directly acceptable on the hosted API. Other
valid sheets are candidate counteroffer packages, not IDs the agent may accept directly.

## Gate A — setup and measured baseline (Runtime + Evaluation)

- [ ] Run root README setup and local checks; record installed kit revision.
- [x] Complete official D01; record serial D02 timing and a one-round concurrent probe.
  See experiment log; sustained concurrency and queued closing remain unverified.
- [ ] Record organizer responses for session queuing, clock start, wave-cap acceptance and units.
- [ ] Agree shared records and module owners in 02 before separate implementations.

## Gate B — economics and closing (Decision + Runtime)

- [ ] Resolve latest quote standards and fixed terms; validate exactly permitted negotiable fields.
- [ ] Compute all C components, must-haves and alternative; handle no alternative explicitly.
- [ ] Per-supplier cost/value estimates with uncertainty for stabilise/secure_supply.
- [ ] Correct exact payment threshold and its current approximation-based test. For the general
  payment comparison, compute both complete costs; x/(1+x) assumes starting at reference terms
  and no other price-linked effects.
- [ ] Margin reference uses cost/(1-m), not cost*(1+m); optimize soft penalty rather than hard floor.
- [x] Shared evaluator handles accept and walk-away, including deadline closure.
- [ ] Reconcile stale/in-flight offers and compare all eligible RFQ packages before closing.

## Gate C — runtime (Runtime)

- [ ] Async client, bounded workers, key-wide limiter, no state locks across awaits.
- [x] Async runner persists logical request ID + exact payload and retries idempotently.
- [ ] Restart reconstructs UTC/server deadlines; does not reuse old monotonic timestamps.
- [ ] Reconcile pending operations, existing sessions and server-counted rounds after errors.
- [ ] End-to-end buyer deadline includes model/parsing/limiter time; bounded fallback.
- [ ] Wave watchdog accounts for queuing; no unvalidated use of kit closing_move.
- [x] CLI dispatches prep/play/run/report. Failure exit-code consistency still needs review.

## Gate D — evidence and model (Evidence + Evaluation)

- [ ] Merge base/release/case context with provenance; include overlay CSVs/documents.
- [ ] Match supplier-specific should-cost rows and price_unit; no double country adjustment.
- [ ] Calendar-aware index windows; unknown data flagged rather than silently zero-filled.
- [ ] Separate external Claim, ProposedTerms and PrivateDecision values.
- [ ] Claim scope ledger includes per-recipient rival quote exception and valid live offer IDs.
- [ ] Unsupported assertion rejected/replaced; ID stripping alone is insufficient.
- [ ] Model receives bounded context; typed reply interpretation is a hypothesis, not authority.
- [ ] Deterministic template reproduces validated packages/claims when model fails.

## Gate E — measured candidate and final readiness (Evaluation + all)

- [ ] Develop against the chosen subset; freeze a holdout before tuning.
- [ ] Compare candidate and baseline with quota-aware repeats and per-case failure analysis.
- [ ] Run concurrent rehearsal and targeted failure tests from 04-experiments.md.
- [ ] Report realized components and aggregate regret separately; no invented optimal components.
- [ ] Produce one replay showing evidence, two candidate packages and actual closing rationale.
- [ ] Sunday overlay + final machine preflight; submit and execute 06-final-runbook.md.

## Scaffold mismatches to fix while implementing

- Shared closing evaluator is now required; obsolete runner fallback removed. Async closing
  uses the same case estimates as the decision policy (explicit runner overrides take precedence).
- guards.check docstring enforces monotonicity and strips IDs: replace with corrected policy.
- claims.build_bank includes weighted decomposition: keep internal unless supported as a checked claim.
- optimizer.payment_breakeven_pct and test currently assert approximation; change together.
- report docstring suggests optimal component regret: output only what actual results support.
- config needs complete model/release wiring; state needs versioning, claim scopes and journal.

Documentation changes do not implement these fixes. Do not mark readiness from passing the
existing scaffold suite alone.

# Start hacking

**Build Tacto. First target: one complete negotiation and an instrumented RFQ sandbox run.**
Do not begin by implementing every strategy or polishing a dashboard.

Team times are Europe/Berlin, Saturday 10 and Sunday 11 October 2026.

## First 15 minutes

1. Assign Runtime, Evidence and Evaluation/pitch owners; Samet owns Decision/integration.
2. Follow [root setup](../README.md). Custom prep/play/run/report commands now execute; serial remains the
   default, async is explicit. Current hosted results are in experiments/LOG.md.
3. Read [implementation gates](10-implementation-checklist.md) together. Agree on package,
   claim, thread-state and closing-proposal records before splitting up.
4. Runtime + Evaluation run D01 and the D02 timing probe. Decision builds full-cost checks.
   Evidence prepares supplier facts and validates units. Save observations, not assumptions.
5. Ask the [design questions](08-open-questions.md): queued RFQ calls, closing near the wave
   cap, price-unit normalization and jury criteria.

## First useful version

One custom case completes end to end. The coordinator exists from the first concurrent runner;
every closing path runs identical checks. Invalid/stale offers cannot be accepted; model work
has a bounded fallback; a request cannot be duplicated on retry. Costs and decisions are traced.
Hosted timing is measured. Then scale to multiple cases.

## Read by role

| Owner | Read first | First deliverable |
|---|---|---|
| Decision / Samet | 02, 03, 10 | Complete-package evaluator and closing policy |
| Runtime | 00, 02, 06, 10 | D02 clock evidence and safe coordinator |
| Evidence | 01, 02, 03 | Typed facts with supplier, part, units and dates |
| Evaluation/pitch | 04, 05, 07 | Baseline report, quota ledger and replay requirements |

## Document map

- [Coding-agent lab playbook](../LAB_PLAYBOOK.md): laptop setup and the tracked experiment workflow.
- [00 — Challenge contract](00-challenge.md): official rules, score, limits and schedule.
- [01 — Research](01-research.md): reproduced findings, estimates and hypotheses.
- [02 — Architecture](02-architecture.md): ownership, state, deadlines and interfaces.
- [03 — Playbook](03-playbook.md): hard checks versus policies to test.
- [04 — Experiments](04-experiments.md): quota, holdout and promotion criteria.
- [05 — Team and timeline](05-team-and-timeline.md): build order and milestones.
- [06 — Final runbook](06-final-runbook.md): release, preflight, freeze and recovery.
- [07 — Pitch](07-pitch.md): demonstrate judgment with measured evidence.
- [08 — Open questions](08-open-questions.md): organizer answers and resulting decisions.
- [09 — Risks](09-risks.md): failure modes and validation.
- [10 — Implementation checklist](10-implementation-checklist.md): actual scaffold gaps and gates.
- [11 — Pipeline and win plan](11-pipeline-and-win-plan.md): one-page order, gates and cut list.
- [12 — Measured improvement plan](12-measured-improvement-plan.md): full hosted coverage, P04 target,
  reproduced policy gaps and the next bounded experiment sequence.

- [13 — Staged experiments](13-staged-experiments.md): current implementation, four-run screening,
  conditional 52-session ceiling, stop gates and FAQ implications. Supersedes document 12's budget.

- [14 — Measured demo](14-measured-demo.md): two defensible replay stories and their limits.

- [12 — Experiment dashboard](12-experiment-dashboard.md): shared laptop-hosted dashboard,
  local experiment runners, comparisons, buffering and importing previous attempts.

- [13 — Agent experiment loop](13-agent-experiment-loop.md): immutable checkpoints, bounded
  comparisons, cited findings, recovery and safe local/recommendation restore.

## Sources and evidence labels

Audited kit and current lockfile: `1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53`.
[Source snapshot](https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/tree/1b5516bb95ef28e37f69aa446dc62168864bca53).
Start with `brief/api.md`, `brief/brief.md`, `brief/submission.md`, `data/company.md`,
`data/README.md` and row-level provenance. Record upgrades and rerun relevant checks.
Resolve conflicting official statements with the desk; public jury weighting is still unresolved.

- **CONTRACT:** official rule/API, subject to recorded organizer clarification.
- **MEASURED LOCAL:** kit/data/simulator reproduction; not hosted persuasion evidence.
- **MEASURED HOSTED:** saved run IDs and configuration support the observation.
- **INFERRED / HYPOTHESIS:** plausible explanation or policy awaiting an experiment.
- **IMPLEMENTED:** code and relevant checks exist; a plan or scaffold test is insufficient.

Hosted sandbox observations are recorded in [the experiment log](../experiments/LOG.md).
They do not establish generalization, final readiness or a winning probability.
# Implementation checklist — read before coding

Snapshot: documentation finalized against scaffold on 10 October 2026. This is an explicit
backlog, not a claim the agent works. Update boxes only with test/run evidence.

## Current implementation

PackageAgent v0.2 uses one closing evaluator through both serial and async orchestration.
The async runner journals requests, reconciles and resumes; one hosted D02 crash/restart
completed the same session with zero timeouts. Prep, reporting and the replay viewer execute.
Verified claims are integrated behind NEGOTIATOR_CLAIMS=1, limited to single-supplier
price-increase cases. P01 improved from 80.0 to 92.8 in a two-repeat comparison. Estimates,
MESOs and claims remain off by default; model interpretation/writing is not implemented.
Full final-machine, wave-cap, concurrent-load and Sunday-release rehearsal remains outstanding.
See the [experiment log](../experiments/LOG.md) for exact scopes and limitations.

Only a supplier's standing (first) sheet is directly acceptable on the hosted API. Other
valid sheets are candidate counteroffer packages, not IDs the agent may accept directly.

## Gate A — setup and measured baseline (Runtime + Evaluation)

- [ ] Run root README setup and local checks; record installed kit revision.
- [x] Complete official D01; record serial D02 timing and a one-round concurrent probe.
  See experiment log; sustained concurrency and queued closing remain unverified.
- [ ] Record organizer responses for session queuing, clock start, wave-cap acceptance and units.
- [ ] Agree shared records and module owners in 02 before separate implementations.

## Gate B — economics and closing (Decision + Runtime)

- [ ] Resolve latest quote standards and fixed terms; validate exactly permitted negotiable fields.
- [ ] Compute all C components, must-haves and alternative; handle no alternative explicitly.
- [ ] Per-supplier cost/value estimates with uncertainty for stabilise/secure_supply.
- [ ] Correct exact payment threshold and its current approximation-based test. For the general
  payment comparison, compute both complete costs; x/(1+x) assumes starting at reference terms
  and no other price-linked effects.
- [ ] Margin reference uses cost/(1-m), not cost*(1+m); optimize soft penalty rather than hard floor.
- [x] Shared evaluator handles accept and walk-away, including deadline closure.
- [ ] Reconcile stale/in-flight offers and compare all eligible RFQ packages before closing.

## Gate C — runtime (Runtime)

- [ ] Async client, bounded workers, key-wide limiter, no state locks across awaits.
- [x] Async runner persists logical request ID + exact payload and retries idempotently.
- [ ] Restart reconstructs UTC/server deadlines; does not reuse old monotonic timestamps.
- [ ] Reconcile pending operations, existing sessions and server-counted rounds after errors.
- [ ] End-to-end buyer deadline includes model/parsing/limiter time; bounded fallback.
- [ ] Wave watchdog accounts for queuing; no unvalidated use of kit closing_move.
- [x] CLI dispatches prep/play/run/report. Failure exit-code consistency still needs review.

## Gate D — evidence and model (Evidence + Evaluation)

- [ ] Merge base/release/case context with provenance; include overlay CSVs/documents.
- [ ] Match supplier-specific should-cost rows and price_unit; no double country adjustment.
- [ ] Calendar-aware index windows; unknown data flagged rather than silently zero-filled.
- [ ] Separate external Claim, ProposedTerms and PrivateDecision values.
- [ ] Claim scope ledger includes per-recipient rival quote exception and valid live offer IDs.
- [ ] Unsupported assertion rejected/replaced; ID stripping alone is insufficient.
- [ ] Model receives bounded context; typed reply interpretation is a hypothesis, not authority.
- [ ] Deterministic template reproduces validated packages/claims when model fails.

All values are C in EUR from `arena_kit.cost.total_cost(case, terms, standard, supplier)`.
"""

import itertools
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from arena_kit.cost import complete_offer, must_haves_ok, total_cost


@dataclass
class Plan:
    c_alt: float  # alternative's C (inf if none)
    c_open: float  # cheapest opening quote's C
    reservation_c: float  # walk-away: never accept above this
    target_c: float  # where we aim
    best_nonprice: dict = field(default_factory=dict)  # cheapest values for non-price fields
    concession_path: list[float] = field(default_factory=list)  # target C per round
    supplier_estimate: dict = field(default_factory=dict)  # full_cost, interest_rate, standard


def plan(case: dict, standard_terms: dict, dossier=None) -> Plan:
    """Reservation, target and concession path. In stabilise/secure_supply, include the
    relationship term with a supplier estimate (should-cost ± sensitivity)."""
    raise NotImplementedError


def meso(case: dict, anchor: dict, c_target: float, n: int = 3) -> list[dict]:
    """n complete term sheets with (nearly) equal C for us but different mixes
    (price-heavy, payment-heavy, term/volume-heavy). Uses arena_kit.cost.complete_offer."""
    raise NotImplementedError


def alternative_cost(case: dict) -> float:
    alt = case["buyer"].get("alternative") or {}
    terms = alt.get("terms") or {}
    return total_cost(case, terms) if terms.get("unit_price") else float("inf")


def best_terms(case: dict, unit_price: float, standard: dict | None = None, supplier=None) -> dict:
    """Complete term sheet at `unit_price` whose non-price fields minimise C and keep the
    must-haves. Fields without listed options keep the buyer's plan (`complete_offer`)."""
    base = complete_offer(case, {"unit_price": unit_price})
    options = case.get("term_options") or {}
    fields = [f for f in case["negotiable"] if f != "unit_price" and options.get(f)]
    best, best_c = base, float("inf")
    for combo in itertools.product(*(options[f] for f in fields)):
        terms = {**base, **dict(zip(fields, combo, strict=True))}
        if not must_haves_ok(case, terms, standard):
            continue
        c = total_cost(case, terms, standard, supplier)
        if c < best_c:
            best, best_c = terms, c
    return best


def payment_breakeven_pct(case: dict, from_days: int, to_days: int) -> float:
    """Price discount (%) that makes paying faster neutral: r · Δdays / 360 · 100."""
    r = case["buyer"]["interest_rate"]
    return r * (from_days - to_days) / 360 * 100

from arena_kit.cost import relationship_cost, supplier_value, total_cost

from negotiator import dossiers as D

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def pkg():
    try:

    except FileNotFoundError:
        pytest.skip("data package not available")


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def built(pkg):
    return D.build(pkg)


def case(goal="stabilise", supplier="sup:70110", part="part:310010", price=126.53) -> dict:
    return {
        "case_id": "case:T", "type": "price_increase", "parts": [part], "suppliers": [supplier],
        "negotiable": ["unit_price", "payment_days"], "fixed_terms": {"lead_time_days": 42, "incoterm": "FCA"},
        "buyer": {"category_goal": goal, "need_per_year": 8150, "horizon_years": 1, "current_unit_price": price,
                  "fallback_unit_price": 145.0, "interest_rate": 0.08, "reference_payment_days": 60,
                  "need_lead_time_days": 42, "freight_eur_per_unit": {"EXW": 2.0, "FCA": 1.2, "DAP": 0.0},
                  "sustainable_margin_pct": 4, "relationship_eur_per_point": 5000},
    }


def test_build_matches_prototype_traits(built):
    assert len(built) == 46
    d = built["sup:70110"]
    assert d.traits >= {"wants_fast_payment", "partnership_owner", "stale_index_owner", "not_tracking_costs"}
    assert traits.evidence(d, "wants_fast_payment")
    assert d.should_cost["part:310010"]["unit_cost"] == 132.64


def test_supplier_estimate_brandlhuber(pkg, built):
    est = D.supplier_estimate(case(), "sup:70110", pkg, built)
    assert est["full_cost"] == 132.64 and est["cost_basis"] == "supplier_plant"
    assert est["full_cost_range"] == (126.01, 139.27)
    assert est["interest_rate"] > est["usual_rate"]  # wants_fast_payment
    assert est["standard"]["payment_days"] == 30 and est["standard"]["incoterm"] == "FCA"
    assert any("margin at current price" in n for n in est["notes"])
    c = case()
    terms = {"unit_price": 136.0, "payment_days": 30}
    assert supplier_value(c, terms, est) > 0
    assert relationship_cost(c, terms, supplier=est) >= 0
    low = relationship_cost(c, {"unit_price": 126.53, "payment_days": 60}, supplier=est)
    assert low > relationship_cost(c, {"unit_price": 140.0, "payment_days": 30}, supplier=est)
    assert total_cost(c, terms, est["standard"], est) > total_cost(c, terms, est["standard"])


def test_cash_short_rate(pkg, built):
    crisis = next(s for s, d in built.items() if "liquidity_crisis" in d.traits)
    part = next(iter(built[crisis].should_cost), "part:310010")
    est = D.supplier_estimate(case(supplier=crisis, part=part), crisis, pkg, built)
    assert est["interest_rate"] == D.CRISIS_RATE
    calm = next(s for s, d in built.items() if not d.traits & traits.CASH_SHORT and d.should_cost)
    est = D.supplier_estimate(case(supplier=calm, part=next(iter(built[calm].should_cost))), calm, pkg, built)
    assert est["interest_rate"] == D.BASE_RATE


def test_non_relationship_goal_returns_none(pkg, built):
    assert D.supplier_estimate(case(goal="leverage"), "sup:70110", pkg, built) is None
    assert D.supplier_estimate(case(goal="leverage"), "sup:70110", pkg, built, force=True)


def test_german_base_row_gets_country_factor(pkg, built):
    row = pkg.query("SELECT part_id FROM should_cost WHERE supplier_id IS NULL OR supplier_id = '' LIMIT 1")[0]
    cz = next(s for s, d in built.items() if d.country == "CZ")
    est = D.supplier_estimate(case(supplier=cz, part=row["part_id"]), cz, pkg, built)
    base = pkg.query("SELECT unit_cost FROM should_cost WHERE part_id = ?", (row["part_id"],))[0]["unit_cost"]
    assert est["cost_basis"] == "german_base"
    assert est["full_cost"] == pytest.approx(base * D.COUNTRY_FACTOR["CZ"], abs=0.01)

    calm = "sup:70520"
    rel = tmp_path / "release-sunday"
    rel.mkdir()
    (rel / "facts.json").write_text(json.dumps({"news:20261011-99": {
        "date": "2026-10-11", "headline": "x", "supplier": calm, "topic": "credit_watch"}}))
    p = D.load_package(str(pkg.root), release=str(rel))
    d = D.build(p)[calm]
    assert "credit_watch" in d.traits
    est = D.supplier_estimate(case(supplier=calm, part="part:350010", price=217.77), calm, p)
    assert est["interest_rate"] == D.CASH_SHORT_RATE

    c = case()
    c["facts"] = {"news:X-1": {"supplier": "sup:70110", "topic": "restructuring", "date": "2026-10-01"}}
    d = D.for_case(built, c)["sup:70110"]
    assert "restructuring" in d.traits and "restructuring" not in built["sup:70110"].traits

from arena_kit.cost import total_cost
from test_runner import ScaledClock, SimArena

from negotiator.agent import PackageAgent
from negotiator.evaluator import close_decision
from negotiator.runner import CaseRunner
from negotiator.state import Journal


@pytest.mark.parametrize("override", [None, {}, {"explicit": {"full_cost": 2}}])
async def test_async_close_uses_same_estimates_as_agent(tmp_path, override):
    clock = ScaledClock()
    arena = SimArena(clock)
    estimates = {"sentinel": {"full_cost": 1}}
    received = []

    def close(case, threads, estimates=None, reason=""):
        received.append(estimates)
        return close_decision(case, threads, estimates, reason)

    agent = PackageAgent(estimates=estimates)
    result = await CaseRunner(arena, "case:S01", agent, Journal(tmp_path / "j.jsonl"),
                              clock=clock, close_fn=close, estimates=override).run()
    assert result["deal"]
    assert received and all(value == (estimates if override is None else override) for value in received)


def test_relationship_cost_can_make_cost_nonmonotonic():
    # Document why inverse-price interpolation must not assume monotonic C when
    # supplier estimates are switched on. This is a property of the arena formula.

    supplier = ESTIMATE["sup:F"]
    assert total_cost(STABILISE, {"unit_price": 20}, supplier=supplier) > total_cost(
        STABILISE, {"unit_price": 40}, supplier=supplier
    )

import itertools

MARKER = "We propose this risk-sharing package in exchange for the attached unit price."
SIGNALS = (
    "cost structure", "cost drivers", "raw material costs", "input costs", "pricing flexibility",
    "cannot accept your", "cannot accept that price", "reject your price", "price is too low",
)


def propose(case, events, scheduled, standard, supplier, deadline, cap_c=None):
    if supplier or latest(events).get("status") != "open":
        return scheduled, None
    if moves_left(case, events) < 3 or deadline - time.time() < 20:
        return scheduled, None
    ours, tried, switches = history(case, events)
    if switches >= 2 or any(m.get("from") == "buyer" and MARKER in m.get("body", "") for m in events):
        return scheduled, None
    trigger = next((m for m in reversed(events) if m.get("from") != "buyer"
                    and any(s in m.get("body", "").lower() for s in SIGNALS)), None)
    if trigger is None:
        return scheduled, None
    options = case.get("term_options", {})
    fields = [f for f in ("index_clause", "contract_months") if f in case["negotiable"] and options.get(f)]
    if not fields:
        return scheduled, None
    current_c = total_cost(case, scheduled, standard)
    cap = min(current_c, cap_c - 0.01) if cap_c is not None else current_c
    choices = []
    for values in itertools.product(*(options[f] for f in fields)):
        candidate = {**scheduled, **dict(zip(fields, values, strict=True))}
        shape = nonprice(case, candidate)
        if shape == nonprice(case, scheduled) or shape in tried:
            continue
        if (candidate.get("index_clause") is None
                and candidate.get("contract_months") == scheduled.get("contract_months")):
            continue  # Removing risk sharing is not a new concession to cost pressure.
        if not permitted(case, candidate) or not must_haves_ok(case, candidate, standard):
            continue
        choices.append((total_cost(case, candidate, standard), candidate))
    if not choices:
        return scheduled, None
    # Compare packages at one price first. Inverse-pricing all options first would hide their differences.
    before, selected = min(choices, key=lambda row: row[0])
    selected = dict(selected)
    selected["unit_price"] = min(scheduled["unit_price"],
                                  math.floor(price_for_cost(case, selected, cap, standard) * 100) / 100)
    after = total_cost(case, selected, standard)
    if not permitted(case, selected) or not must_haves_ok(case, selected, standard) or after > cap + 0.01:
        return scheduled, None
    return complete_offer(case, selected), {
        "source_message": trigger.get("message_id"), "considered": len(choices),
        "scheduled": scheduled, "scheduled_cost": current_c, "same_price_package_cost": before,
        "selected": selected, "selected_cost": after,
        "reason": "lowest-cost permitted risk-sharing switch, repriced to preserve buyer cost",
    }

Audit is read-only; no hosted quota consumed.

The regression is economically explained, not a timeout or claim failure. Saved run `5eccc847-d1ca-4a90-a3f4-a873b32640c1` closed a valid €349.37 / 90-day / 5% clause deal, with zero timeouts and one verified claim. Relative to the €373.65 no-clause baseline:

- Purchase cost: **−€148,350.80**
- Payment benefit lost: **+€989.01**
- Index risk: **+€17,077.21**
- Relationship penalty: **+€140,072.44**
- Complete cost: **+€9,787.85**, from €2,268,972.94 to €2,278,760.79
- Score: **29.3422 → 8.6724**

The candidate logged only **€2,138,688.35** at acceptance because its config injected `estimates={}`. Therefore it omitted exactly the observed €140,072.44 relationship term.

The supplier explicitly reacted positively to the clause, offering €351.90 immediately and retaining it through closure. Subsequent price grinding from €351.90 to €349.37 could itself worsen complete cost: under the public point estimate, the first indexed quote costs €2,345,368.80 and the last €2,354,852.01. The economic assumption “lower price always improves C” is false.

Critical grounded facts:

- P02 is `stabilise`, with sustainable margin **0.5%** and **€31,920 per margin point**.
- Index forecast is +5%; therefore the 5% clause has **zero index-path charge**, but still adds the 4% index-risk premium on the 20% share.
- Kit `supplier_value` explicitly excludes index clauses and contract security from supplier cash value. Risk sharing cannot cancel the relationship penalty mathematically.
- [cost.py](/Users/sametdegirmenci/Downloads/ysamet/negotiation-arena-kit/starter-kit/arena_kit/cost.py:71)
- Existing [price_for_cost](/Users/sametdegirmenci/Downloads/ysamet/tacto-negotiator/src/negotiator/evaluator.py:89) assumes increasing C; simply enabling estimates leaves this broken.
- `cost_trade.propose` currently disables itself whenever a supplier estimate exists. Removing that guard alone is unsafe.

Offline thresholds reproduce the earlier arithmetic **only without relationship**:

- No clause: baseline C €2,268,972.94.
- 0% deadband: largest cent price strictly beating baseline **€366.99**.
- 3%: **€369.18**.
- 5%: **€370.66**.
- 30-day/no-clause: **€368.70**.

These are not valid complete-cost targets under supplier uncertainty.

Public dossier estimate is **€374.95 ±5%**, from supplier-specific `cost:350011`; range **€356.20–€393.70**, interest assumption 8%, standard payment 30 days. It predicts:

- Baseline relationship cost **€15,505.12**, versus observed zero.
- Failed deal relationship cost **€216,163.66**, versus observed €140,072.44.

Thus the point estimate directionally catches the regression but is not calibrated. Do not reverse-engineer a hidden supplier cost from the result and feed it into runtime.

Using the public central estimate:

- Best no-clause / 90-day package: approximately **€369.27**, C **€2,279,513.14**.
- Best 5% clause / 90-day package: approximately **€369.17**, C **€2,297,560.62**.
- No price with any indexed package at 90 days beats the central-estimated baseline C €2,284,478.06.
- Faster payment remains a valid lever: no-clause optimum at 14 days is approximately **€363.05**, C **€2,279,260.00**. “Payment is used up” was also based on incomplete economics.
- But the 14-day optimum ranges from **€345.44 to €380.62** across the published cost uncertainty. A hard margin floor or unqualified central-estimate optimum is not justified.

Smallest general correction:

1. Add a relationship-aware package-selection path for relationship goals with usable public estimates. Carry low/central/high costs consistently through proposal, switching and every closing path.
2. Replace monotonic inverse pricing in that path with bounded minimization and feasible price intervals; return explicit infeasible status when a requested C lies below the minimum. Never default to a near-zero price.
3. Compare all permitted payment/clause combinations and supplier-proposed alternatives on complete C. Rank uncertainty using incremental regret against current live offers, with the same policy in proposal and closing. Historical scores, prices and result-derived supplier values remain evaluation-only.
4. Do not force a clause. Even the central estimate rules it out economically in this case. Strict all-scenario improvement against the initial live quote permits only a tiny no-clause/14-day improvement around €369.64; it permits no indexed package. That is a legitimate gate failure, not grounds to relax the gate silently.
5. Counter an advantageous alternative term sheet and wait for a directly acceptable standing sheet; alternative IDs cannot be accepted.

Required tests: decreasing-C region, two roots/feasible interval, unattainable target, cent rounding, zero/invalid supplier cash value, absent estimate, full-cost sensitivity, quote-standard precedence, forbidden contract changes, clause persistence, alternative-sheet countering, shared serial/async closing estimates, and proof that runtime does not load historical results. The existing relationship nonmonotonicity test already establishes the key defect.

Continuous uncertainty validation confirms a conservative payment trade is locally feasible:

- Against evaluation-only €373.65 / 90-day / no clause: **€367.36 / 14-day / no clause** improves complete cost by **at least €250.47** throughout the public €356.20–€393.70 supplier-cost range.
- Against the actual initial live quote €370.96 / 30-day / no clause: **€369.64 / 14-day / no clause** improves C by **at least €36.47**.
- No indexed package passes the same conservative gate. Even the best 5% package worsens worst-case incremental C by €17,706.09 against the historical baseline.
- The observed €367.02 and €368.45 / 14-day alternatives fail baseline dominance: worst-case increases €808.69 and €6,460.58 respectively.

These calculations evaluate the whole cost interval: endpoints, candidate/reference relationship breakpoints at margin gaps 0 and 5, and interior stationary points. Checking only low/middle/high misses the €368.45 alternative’s worst case.

The smallest viable general hypothesis is **cash-equivalent faster-payment exchange**: preserve all other terms, derive a candidate price that preserves supplier cash value relative to a fresh live standing offer, examine neighboring cents, and require complete-cost improvement across the interval. It produces the same optima above without using historical targets or treating uncertain sustainable margin as a price floor.

The live opening trade alone does **not** demonstrate an improvement over score 29.34. A fresh no-clause quote near the previous 90-day outcome would permit a robust faster-payment counter capable of clearing the offline baseline gate; supplier acceptance remains unmeasured.

A cent-price convex solver is viable using **unrounded component sums**, positive affine supplier cash value, and exact uncertainty extrema. Maximum incremental C over supplier-cost scenarios is convex in price under the kit’s valid economic domain. Use convex search followed by neighboring-cent verification; do not optimize rounded `total_cost` directly.
